assessment_summary.cou_name: Heat sink fin geometry downselect and TIM screening at bench point (~1.5 m/s in test shroud)

evidence_keywords: Grid study: Three meshes
3.1M, 6.2M, 12.4M cells
Estimated observed order ~1.9
GCI on the medium grid ≈ 2.8%
Residuals <1e‑4 for energy and turbulence scalars
continuity/momentum to 3e‑4
Key monitors (die heat flux, die-center temperature, fan mass flow) flat within 0.1 C and 0.5%
Steady RANS with SST k–ω was used
radiation was included via gray-body S2S
Fan: Implemented as a pressure-jump boundary
swirl neglected after a check
A 60 s power pulse trial run shows <0.8 C lag
Inputs pedigree:
TIM thickness (50 ± 10 µm) measured by micrometer
effective k = 3.0 W/m‑K from supplier laminated sheet spec
squeeze‑flow coupon test series
Aluminum k(T) curve (6061‑T6) from MatWeb
board-level rig
Gen4 inverter module
Contact resistance was inferred from coupons, not the assembled stack
Delta FFB0412VHN fan running at 12 V
1.6 m/s inlet speed
inside the test shroud
AMCA 210 correction applied to fan P–Q
emissivity correction at 0.86
pressure-jump boundary with the vendor’s quadratic P–Q fit
AMCA 210 correction applied to fan P–Q
bolt preload in the rig is lower than in the coupons
Match to lab data:
die-center temperature of 83.7 C vs. 85.0 C measured
Heatsink base midline: 71.9 C vs. 75.0 C measured
Duct pressure drop across the sink: 160 Pa predicted vs. 151 Pa measured
IR camera FLIR A655sc cross-check within 0.6 C
